controls: Three public frontend compilers retain interpreter/cwd/timeout and argv literals
Unsupported options, escaping paths and symlinks reject before execution
Fresh managed world + real actor preflight/RPC retain same source, quota and final lock; public subprocess callback is scripted
Public contract rejects task/interpreter/environment envelope mismatch
Native convenience refuses host before spawning a task test process
Copied public CLI and library load without private runtime and refuse host

boundary: These CPU controls establish selection/schema/protocol behavior, not deployed container readiness or measured score improvement.
unobserved_prior_sdk_stdout: One earlier SDK CPU command completed but its stdout was unavailable after context truncation; no pass claim relies on that attempt. The saved sdk-control is the necessary replacement check.
